text.p: Canadian Bond Rating Service said it reaffirmed the credit ratings of TransCanada PipeLines Ltd and upgraded the firm's outlook to positive from stable due to its consistent pattern of earnings and cashflow growth.

TransCanada's ratings remain at A-1 (Low) for its commercial paper, A (High) for its first mortgage bonds, A for its debentures and term notes, B++ (High) for its subordinated debentures and P-2/P-2 (Low) for its preferred shares, CBRS said.
"CBRS expects continuation of steady income and cashflow performance from TransCanada's mainline and interconnected pipelines," it said.

"The rating outlook assumes that with increasing non-utility investments, TransCanada's financial profile and credit ratios will remain within the parameters established for 'single A' companies," it added.
TransCanada is the second largest Canadian transporter of natural gas in Canada.
